300.comment: confetti brand Red, lifted — reads on the darker surfaces but not on card (3.50:1). Only usable as the dark accent when `card` is close to black, which it no longer is.

200.comment: confetti brand Red, lifted furthest — the palest step, and the ONLY one that reads AS TEXT on every dark surface including `card` (4.96:1). This is also the ceiling that fixes how light `card` can go: there is nothing paler to fall back on.

600.comment: deepened Red — the danger family's dark step.

green.$comment: STATUS green — success. Not a brand hue and not one of the four confetti accents: it means one thing, so it sits on the status roles and is shared by every theme rather than being repointed per brand.

800.comment: deep tint — the subtle end of the pair in DARK mode, carrying chalk (10.37:1)

700.comment: success AS TEXT on a light surface (4.86:1 on the old cream; 5.0:1 on porcelain)

600.comment: the rich green — success as a FILL, carrying a white label (5.34:1). Same in both modes; a fill does not need to move.

400.comment: success AS TEXT on a dark surface — lifted enough to clear AA on card, the lightest dark surface (5.5:1)

100.comment: pale tint — the subtle end of the pair in LIGHT mode, carrying green.700 (5.25:1)

colors.$comment-confetti-accents: The four confetti hues. Each ramp reads 100 (pale tint, light mode) → 400 (bold, light mode) → 500 (bold, DARK mode — same hue pushed for chroma so it reads as a choice on gray rather than a dusty pastel) → 700 (deep tint, dark mode).
colors.$comment-adventure: Adventure theme (Forest & trail) — pine brand, sand light neutrals, forest dark neutrals, warm bark ink, and four earthy accent hues.

500.comment: Adventure brand green — reads as text on sand (4.8:1) and as button fill w/ white (6.6:1)

300.comment: brand, lifted enough to read AS TEXT on the forest dark surface

a12.comment: bark at 12% — subtle border on sand

600.comment: warm near-black — Adventure light-mode text and borders

a16.comment: sand at 16% — subtle border on forest

colors.$comment-neon: Neon theme (80s–90s synthwave) — magenta brand, cyan/purple/lime accents, light-lavender (haze) light surfaces, deep-purple (synth) dark surfaces.

600.comment: deep magenta — brand AS TEXT on light

900.comment: neon light text / border — deep purple

100.comment: neon dark text / border — light lavender

midnight.$comment: Midnight — Confetti's dark mode, and the deep ground of its code blocks and dark panels. The page is a rich indigo-black; the raised surfaces above it are a luxurious dark charcoal with only a tiny hint of indigo, so cards read as dark and quiet rather than bright. The four surface steps (800 page, 700 raised, 600 panel, 500 card) are evenly spaced in luminance, so each layer reads as one step up and depth comes from layering. Numbered by luminance: 100 lightest, 900 darkest. The named alpha steps at the end are the glow and edge light used on hover and at the top of a card.

300.comment: muted text — 8.61:1 on page, 7.18:1 on card, the lightest surface

400.comment: muted text on the deep ground — 6.35:1 on 900

450.comment: hover fill for a dark control — a clear step above card (a half-step, since it sits between the card surface and the text steps); 12.4:1 with text

500.comment: card — dark charcoal with a tiny hint of indigo. The lightest surface, and so the one that sets the contrast floor: the palest brand red still reads at 7.32:1 on it

600.comment: panel chrome — between raised and card

700.comment: raised — the canvas one step above page, a grayer charcoal

900.comment: recessed mat below page; also the deep ground of code blocks and dark panels

glow.comment: the halo on hover — a saturated indigo, bright enough to read as light rather than shadow, close to a neon tube

glow-edge.comment: the bright edge that defines the halo — near full strength, like the lit rim of a neon tube

highlight.comment: a faint light along the top edge of a surface — the sheen that separates a raised card from the page

porcelain.$comment: Luxury white — Confetti's light mode. A clean, bright white with only the faintest cool cast (matching the midnight ramp's hue, so the two modes read as one brand) and an indigo-black ink. No cream, no yellow. Numbered by luminance: 50 lightest, 900 darkest. The four surface steps (white card, 50 raised, 100 page, 200 panel) are close but evenly spaced, so each layer reads as one step and the hairline border does the separating.

50.comment: raised — the canvas one step above page, at the midpoint between page and card

200.comment: panel chrome — one step below page

300.comment: hover fill for a light control — a clear step below panel; 14.5:1 with ink

400.comment: recessed mat below page — app frames, control tracks

600.comment: muted text — 5.47:1 on page, 5.86:1 on card, 4.85:1 on panel

a24.comment: default border, and the halo on a card's hover
